g.text: Restaurant Rush | Stage 3 control and boundary (view 2 of 2)
Boundary: numbered staff choices and manager text input.
Reads currentRole(), legalActions and Happy Hour fields;
never computes prices, eligibility or satisfaction.
Only this control object advances phases and turns.
Accepted action: HOST -> WAITER -> CHEF -> TURN_END.
Rejection leaves state/capacity unchanged; retry same role.
Legacy constructor (without Host) and beginTurn() remain.
Record accessors are public (e.g. turn(), legalActions()).
TableView, OrderView and GameEvent are value records;
omitted members are detailed in the Java source / contract.
Every record containing a list copies it defensively.
chef: Chef, cashier: Cashier, arrivals: IntFunction<Customer>)
+ public; - private; ~ package-private. Solid arrows: retained object references.
Dashed arrows: calls, construction, parameters or returned values; they are not retained fields.
Fields/methods are selected for design evidence; this is not a complete API listing.
Domain relationships continue in view 1. Selected key members; records expose generated public accessors.
Source baseline: d38231a. Happy Hour is state plus behavior, not a separate policy class in this implementation.
